take: The bye is close to locked (96.7%), so your season is really two games: Week 16 and Week 17. Every move below is judged mostly on those two lineups, with Weeks 12 to 14 still counted so nobody who stinks until then sneaks in.
You win it all in 24.1% of sims. Your biggest threat is Chasing Brown Huzz at 25.5%. That's down from 38.1% last update.
Best trade they should actually accept: D'Andre Swift for Caleb Douglas + Garrett Wilson with Faiz's Fantastic Team. Title odds +2.4 and their lineup moves +1.0 a week.
Backup plan: D'Andre Swift for Rashee Rice + Ashton Jeanty (Griffin's Great Team), +2.0.
Swing big if they bite: D'Andre Swift for Jonah Coleman + Jameson Williams (BO liever) is worth +5.1, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: C.J. Stroud getting hurt costs you 19.2 points of title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
Waivers: Chig Okonkwo (TE) for Jordan Addison adds about 9.5 weighted lineup points.
